question.text: GST on Management Fees is typically charged:

answer.text: At 18%, usually over and above the stated management fee %

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.7.2, GST @ 18% is typically charged over and above the stated management fee percentage. The Trap: Other rates don't apply to management services. Cross-Exam Context: Same 18% GST used in Topic 5 fee examples. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Disclose fees as 'all-in' (incl. GST) for true cost transparency.
